exclusions.source_text: History of another malignancy except for the following: adequately treated local basal cell or squamous carcinoma of the skin, in situ cervical cancer, adequately treated papillary noninvasive bladder cancer, other adequately treated Stage I or Stage II cancers currently in complete remission
Clinically significant cardiovascular event, including myocardial infarction, arterial thromboembolism, or cerebrovascular thromboembolism, within 6 months
Known active CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis
Significant liver disease (Child Pugh class B or C)
exclusions.threshold: Child Pugh class B or C
